sourceArticle.title: Superset - Run 10+ parallel coding agents on your machine
sourceArticle.author: Superset Team

athenaOutput.directive: Reaffirm the strategic decision to integrate parallel agent orchestration natively into the Creative Liberation Engine as a first-class module, building upon the existing 'Native Creative Liberation Engine Swarm Module' initiative.
athenaOutput.rationale: The core concept presented by Superset, 'Run 10+ parallel coding agents on your machine,' directly aligns with and is already encompassed by ATHENA's prior strategic decision to integrate parallel agent orchestration natively into the Creative Liberation Engine. This was established as the 'Native Creative Liberation Engine Swarm Module' to ensure sovereignty and deep integration, as per the KEEPER knowledge context. Therefore, the topic of Superset is redundant as a new ideation prompt; instead, it serves as external validation for an existing, high-priority strategic direction within the Creative Liberation Engine.
